description: This file defines internal sealed classes providing descriptions for well-known codecs and copiers within the Orleans code generator, specifically encapsulating type symbols for underlying types and codec/copier types.

classes.name: WellKnownCodecDescription
classes.description: Encapsulates the underlying type and codec type symbols for a well-known codec.

classes.name: WellKnownCopierDescription
classes.description: Encapsulates the underlying type and copier type symbols for a well-known copier, implementing ICopierDescription.

methods.name: WellKnownCodecDescription
methods.description: Constructor initializing the underlying type and codec type symbols.

methods.name: WellKnownCopierDescription
methods.description: Constructor initializing the underlying type and copier type symbols.
